builder.title: Write your kvittel
builder.intro: Write freely. What you see on the right is exactly what will be printed at the tziyun.

grave.title: Tziyun
grave.chooseHint: You can add more than one
grave.addAnother: Send to another tziyun as well
grave.multiNote: The same kvittel will be printed separately at each tziyun.
grave.printedName: Name of the tzaddik as printed
grave.printedNameHint: Printed exactly as written here — never changed automatically.

nusach.title: Language of the kvittel
nusach.hint: Sets words such as “ben / bat” on the slip. Your text is printed exactly as you type it.

people.title: Names
people.hint: Traditionally the person’s name with their mother’s name. Write it any way you prefer.

request.title: Your words
request.hint: Your own words come first. Suggestions below are optional.
request.label: Request
request.placeholder: Write what is in your heart…

en.0: For a complete recovery and good health
en.1: For success and an honourable livelihood
en.2: With gratitude for all the good

fr.0: Pour une guérison complète et une bonne santé
fr.1: Pour la réussite et une subsistance honorable
fr.2: Avec gratitude pour tout le bien

ru.0: О полном выздоровлении и крепком здоровье

hand.title: Handwritten kvittel
hand.hint: Optional — attach a photo of a kvittel you wrote by hand.
hand.formats: JPG or PNG, up to 8 MB
hand.noAi: Your handwriting is kept as an image. We never alter or “correct” your words.

errors.type: Please choose a JPG or PNG image.
errors.size: The image is larger than 8 MB.
errors.decode: This image could not be read.

finish.title: Finishing
finish.signatureHint: For example a family name. Leave empty to stay anonymous.

privacy.remember: Remember this draft on this device
privacy.rememberHint: Off by default: your draft is erased when you close this tab. On a shared computer, leave this off.
privacy.wipeConfirm: Erase this draft and your basket from this device?

preview.label: Live preview
preview.title: Your kvittel
preview.meta: {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} · approx. {mm} mm of paper
preview.exact: Drawn by the same engine and fonts as the printer. The date line shows the actual print date.

warnings.too_long: The kvittel is too long ({detail} pages). Please shorten it.
warnings.empty: Add at least one name or a few words.
warnings.name_missing_parent: {detail, plural, one {One name has} other {# names have}} no mother’s or father’s name. That is fine — just checking.
warnings.grave_name_empty: Please enter the name of the tzaddik as it should be printed.
warnings.invalid: Something in the form is not valid.

picker.title: Choose a tziyun
picker.subtitle: Only tziyunim with a working unit can be selected.
